audit_metadata.scope: README.md, all module docstrings, missing examples, missing tutorials, missing API references, missing deployment guides

gaps.title: No LICENSE file
gaps.description: README references 'MIT License — see LICENSE for details' but no LICENSE file exists in the repository root.
gaps.impact: Legal ambiguity; users cannot verify license terms. The README's license reference is broken.
gaps.recommendation: Add a standard MIT LICENSE file with the copyright holder and year.

gaps.title: No pyproject.toml or setup.py
gaps.description: README instructs 'pip install -e .' but there is no pyproject.toml, setup.py, or setup.cfg. The package cannot be installed.
gaps.impact: The documented installation command fails. Users cannot install the package.
gaps.recommendation: Create a pyproject.toml with build-system, project metadata, dependencies, and optional-dependencies for GPU (torch), edge AI (onnxruntime), and API (fastapi, uvicorn) extras.

gaps.title: No requirements.txt or environment.yml
gaps.description: No pinned dependency file exists. README lists 'pip install pytest numpy onnx onnxruntime' but this is incomplete (missing torch, fastapi, pydantic, PyJWT, requests, rdflib).
gaps.impact: Users cannot reproduce the environment. Missing dependencies cause import errors.
gaps.recommendation: Add requirements.txt with all runtime dependencies and requirements-dev.txt with test/lint tools. Consider environment.yml for conda users.

gaps.title: No CONTRIBUTING.md
gaps.description: No contribution guidelines exist. New contributors have no guidance on code style, PR process, or development setup.
gaps.impact: Barrier to external contributions; inconsistent code quality from lack of standards.
gaps.recommendation: Add CONTRIBUTING.md covering: dev environment setup, code style (formatter, linter), PR process, commit message conventions, testing requirements.

gaps.title: No CHANGELOG.md
gaps.description: No changelog exists. Users cannot track what changed between versions.
gaps.impact: Poor maintainability; users cannot assess upgrade risk.
gaps.recommendation: Add CHANGELOG.md following Keep a Changelog format. Document the initial release.

gaps.title: No CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
gaps.description: No code of conduct exists for the community.
gaps.impact: Missing community standards; less welcoming to new contributors.
gaps.recommendation: Adopt the Contributor Covenant v2.1 as CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.

gaps.title: No SECURITY.md
gaps.description: No security policy exists. The project has a security module (JWT, RBAC, rate limiting, GPS anti-spoofing) but no documented security reporting process.
gaps.impact: Security vulnerabilities have no disclosure channel; users don't know how to report issues.
gaps.recommendation: Add SECURITY.md with supported versions, reporting process, and scope (aligned with the zero-trust architecture).

gaps.title: No examples/ directory
gaps.description: No runnable examples exist. README shows a single TSP snippet but there are no complete, runnable example scripts for any module.
gaps.impact: High onboarding friction; users must read source code to understand usage patterns.
gaps.recommendation: Create examples/ directory with: basic_tsp.py, basic_vrp.py, swarm_coordination.py, iot_pipeline.py, digital_twin_sim.py, decision_support.py, api_gateway_demo.py, genomics_demo.py, end_to_end_farm.py.

gaps.title: No docs/ directory
gaps.description: No documentation site or structured docs directory exists. All documentation is in README.md only.
gaps.impact: Cannot scale documentation; no place for detailed guides, API references, or tutorials.
gaps.recommendation: Create docs/ directory with: index.md, getting-started.md, architecture.md, modules/, api/, tutorials/, deployment/, faq/, glossary.md. Consider MkDocs or Sphinx for site generation.

gaps.title: No tutorials
gaps.description: No step-by-step tutorials exist for any workflow (e.g., 'Deploy a digital twin', 'Set up IoT pipeline', 'Design CRISPR guides').
gaps.impact: Users cannot learn workflows; only API-level snippets available.
gaps.recommendation: Create tutorials/ with: 01-getting-started.md, 02-optimization-basics.md, 03-swarm-coordination.md, 04-iot-data-pipeline.md, 05-digital-twin-simulation.md, 06-decision-support.md, 07-api-gateway.md, 08-genomics.md, 09-end-to-end-farm.md, 10-deployment.md.

gaps.title: No API reference documentation
gaps.description: No API reference exists. The FastAPI app has auto-generated docs at /docs but there is no comprehensive API documentation for the Python library itself (classes, methods, parameters, return types).
gaps.impact: Users must read source code to understand the API. No searchable reference.
gaps.recommendation: Generate API docs with pdoc, Sphinx autodoc, or mkdocstrings. Document all public classes, methods, dataclasses, and their parameters/returns.

gaps.title: No deployment guides
gaps.description: No deployment documentation exists. No Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud deployment guides despite the project having a multi-layer architecture (edge, cloud, AI, application).
gaps.impact: Users cannot deploy the system. No guidance on production deployment.
gaps.recommendation: Create deployment/ with: docker.md (Dockerfile + docker-compose for full stack), kubernetes.md (K8s manifests), cloud.md (AWS/GCP/Azure deployment), edge.md (Jetson/Raspberry Pi deployment), production-checklist.md.

gaps.title: No Dockerfile or docker-compose.yml
gaps.description: No container configuration exists. The project has multiple services (API gateway, dashboard, IoT pipeline) but no containerization.
gaps.impact: Cannot containerize for deployment; no reproducible runtime environment.
gaps.recommendation: Add Dockerfile (multi-stage, slim base) and docker-compose.yml (API gateway + dashboard + MQTT broker + TimescaleDB + Kafka).

gaps.title: No CI/CD configuration
gaps.description: No GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or other CI/CD pipeline exists. No automated testing, linting, or building.
gaps.impact: No automated quality gates; regressions can merge silently.
gaps.recommendation: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml with: lint (ruff/black), type-check (mypy), test (pytest with coverage), build (package build). Add release workflow.

gaps.title: No Makefile
gaps.description: No Makefile for common development tasks (install, test, lint, format, docs, clean).
gaps.impact: Developer friction; no standard task runner.
gaps.recommendation: Add Makefile with targets: install, install-dev, test, test-coverage, lint, format, typecheck, docs, clean, docker-build.

gaps.title: No .env.example
gaps.description: No example environment file. The project uses secrets (JWT secret, database passwords) but documents no environment variable conventions.
gaps.impact: Users don't know what env vars are needed; risk of committing secrets.
gaps.recommendation: Add .env.example with: JWT_SECRET, DATABASE_URL, MQTT_BROKER_URL, KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS, TIMESCALEDB_URL, API_PORT, LOG_LEVEL.

gaps.title: No PR template or issue templates
gaps.description: No .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md or .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ directory.
gaps.impact: Inconsistent PR/issue quality; missing context in submissions.
gaps.recommendation: Add PR template (description, testing, checklist) and issue templates (bug report, feature request, documentation).

gaps.title: No architecture decision records (ADRs)
gaps.description: No docs/adr/ directory. Key architectural choices (in-memory vs. real backends, PBFT consensus approach, NGSI-LD integration) are undocumented.
gaps.impact: Lost design context; future maintainers don't know why decisions were made.
gaps.recommendation: Create docs/adr/ with: 0001-in-memory-backends.md, 0002-pbft-consensus-simulation.md, 0003-ngsi-ld-integration.md, 0004-fastapi-for-api-gateway.md, 0005-pytorch-for-gpu-optimization.md.

gaps.title: No testing guide
gaps.description: README shows basic pytest commands but no comprehensive testing guide (test organization, fixtures, mocking strategy, coverage goals, E2E testing).
gaps.impact: New contributors don't know how to write tests; inconsistent test quality.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/testing.md covering: test structure, running tests, writing unit tests, integration tests, E2E tests, coverage requirements, mocking external services.

gaps.title: No performance tuning guide
gaps.description: No documentation on performance characteristics, benchmarking, or tuning. The project has GPU acceleration and performance tests but no guide.
gaps.impact: Users cannot optimize deployments; no baseline performance data documented.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/performance.md with: benchmark methodology, baseline results, GPU vs. CPU comparison, tuning parameters (batch size, thread counts, optimization levels).

gaps.title: No troubleshooting guide
gaps.description: No FAQ or troubleshooting documentation. Common issues (GPU not found, ONNX model loading failures, MQTT connection problems) are undocumented.
gaps.impact: Users struggle with common issues; increased support burden.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/troubleshooting.md and docs/faq.md with common issues and solutions.

gaps.title: No glossary
gaps.description: No glossary of agricultural and technical terms. The domain uses specialized vocabulary (AGROVOC, NGSI-LD, PBFT, boustrophedon, PAM site, etc.).
gaps.impact: Barrier for users unfamiliar with agricultural or distributed systems terminology.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/glossary.md with terms: AGROVOC, NGSI-LD, PBFT, TSP, VRP, CPP, MRTA, MAPF, PAM, CRISPR, boustrophedon, Christofides, Clarke-Wright, etc.

gaps.title: No code style guide
gaps.description: No documented code style conventions. The codebase uses type hints and docstrings but there's no formal style guide or enforced linter config.
gaps.impact: Inconsistent code style; review friction.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/style-guide.md and configure ruff/black/mypy in pyproject.toml. Document naming conventions, docstring format (Google/NumPy), type hint requirements.

gaps.title: No onboarding guide for new developers
gaps.description: No developer onboarding documentation. New team members have no guided path to understand the codebase.
gaps.impact: Slow ramp-up for new developers.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/onboarding.md with: codebase tour, key concepts, first tasks, development workflow, where to get help.

gaps.title: No data flow documentation beyond README diagrams
gaps.description: README has Mermaid diagrams but no detailed data flow documentation (schema definitions, event formats, API contracts).
gaps.impact: Integration partners lack interface specifications.
gaps.recommendation: Add docs/data-flows.md with: MQTT topic schema, Kafka message format, NGSI-LD entity schemas, API request/response examples, WebSocket message format.

gaps.title: All __init__.py files are empty
gaps.description: All 8 __init__.py files (src/, optimization/, path_planning/, multi_agent/, iot/, digital_twin/, decision_support/, genomics/) are completely empty. No package docstrings, no re-exports, no __all__ definitions.
gaps.impact: No package-level documentation; IDEs cannot show package help; no public API surface definition.
gaps.recommendation: Add module docstrings to each __init__.py describing the package purpose. Re-export key classes for convenient imports. Define __all__ for explicit public API.

gaps.title: Missing function/method docstrings in optimization module
gaps.description: Several public methods lack docstrings: TSPSolver.__init__, TSPSolver.solve, VRPSolver.__init__, VRPSolver.solve, GPUTSPSolver.__init__, GPUTSPSolver.solve, GPUVRPSolver.__init__, GPUVRPSolver.solve, CoveragePlanner.__init__, CoveragePlanner.plan.
gaps.impact: IDE tooltips and generated docs are incomplete.
gaps.recommendation: Add Google-style docstrings with Args, Returns, Raises sections to all public methods.

gaps.title: Missing function/method docstrings in multi_agent module
gaps.description: SwarmCoordinator.__init__ has docstring but many methods lack full documentation. ByzantineConsensus.propose and tally_votes have minimal docstrings. TaskAllocator methods lack parameter documentation.
gaps.impact: Incomplete API documentation for swarm coordination.
gaps.recommendation: Add comprehensive docstrings to all public methods with examples.

gaps.title: Missing function/method docstrings in iot module
gaps.description: MQTTClient, KafkaStream, and TimescaleDBStorage have class docstrings but many public methods lack parameter/return documentation. NGSILDBroker methods have minimal docstrings.
gaps.impact: IoT module API is poorly documented for external users.
gaps.recommendation: Add docstrings to all public methods with type information and examples.

gaps.title: Missing function/method docstrings in digital_twin module
gaps.description: DigitalTwin.__init__ and simulate have docstrings but _step, _temp_factor, _water_factor lack them. AgriKnowledgeGraph methods have minimal docstrings. AGROVOCOntology methods lack parameter docs.
gaps.impact: Digital twin and knowledge graph APIs are under-documented.
gaps.recommendation: Add docstrings to all public methods, especially query methods and serialization.

gaps.title: Missing function/method docstrings in decision_support module
gaps.description: DecisionEngine.recommend has docstring but FarmDashboard, AlertManager, APIGateway, ZeroTrustAuth, GPSSpoofingDetector methods lack comprehensive documentation.
gaps.impact: Decision support and security APIs are poorly documented.
gaps.recommendation: Add docstrings to all public methods with security considerations noted.

gaps.title: Missing function/method docstrings in genomics module
gaps.description: CRISPRDesigner and ProteinAnalyzer have class docstrings but methods lack parameter documentation and examples.
gaps.impact: Genomics module is hard to use without reading source.
gaps.recommendation: Add docstrings with biological context and usage examples.

gaps.title: Missing function/method docstrings in edge_ai and crop_vision
gaps.description: EdgeAIInference has good class docstrings but many methods lack full documentation. CropVisionPipeline methods have minimal docstrings.
gaps.impact: Edge AI APIs are under-documented for deployment scenarios.
gaps.recommendation: Add deployment-focused docstrings with hardware requirements and performance notes.

gaps.title: README Quick Start is incomplete
gaps.description: Quick Start shows only TSP usage. No examples for VRP, swarm, IoT, digital twin, decision support, API gateway, or genomics. No end-to-end example.
gaps.impact: Users only learn about 1 of 18 modules from the Quick Start.
gaps.recommendation: Expand Quick Start with a 'Module Examples' section showing basic usage for each module. Add an end-to-end farm simulation example.

gaps.title: README Testing section is minimal
gaps.description: Testing section shows only basic pytest commands. No explanation of test organization, fixtures, mocking strategy, or how to add tests for new modules.
gaps.impact: New contributors don't know how to write tests.
gaps.recommendation: Expand Testing section with: test file naming conventions, fixture usage, mocking external services, coverage requirements, E2E test explanation.

gaps.title: README Security section lacks usage examples
gaps.description: Security section lists features (JWT, RBAC, rate limiting, GPS anti-spoofing) but shows no code examples of how to use ZeroTrustAuth or GPSSpoofingDetector.
gaps.impact: Users cannot implement security without reading source code.
gaps.recommendation: Add code examples for: generating/validating JWT tokens, checking roles, rate limiting, GPS spoofing detection.

gaps.title: README Interoperability section lacks integration examples
gaps.description: Interoperability section lists standards (NGSI-LD, ADAPT, AGROVOC, ISO 18497, MAVLink) but shows no integration code examples.
gaps.impact: Users cannot implement integrations without reading source.
gaps.recommendation: Add examples for: creating NGSI-LD entities, querying AGROVOC ontology, working with knowledge graph.

gaps.title: README GPU Acceleration section lacks setup instructions
gaps.description: GPU section lists requirements but no setup instructions (CUDA installation, PyTorch CUDA build, ONNX Runtime GPU provider configuration).
gaps.impact: Users cannot set up GPU acceleration without external research.
gaps.recommendation: Add step-by-step GPU setup: CUDA toolkit install, PyTorch CUDA wheel, onnxruntime-gpu install, verification script.

gaps.title: README lacks module interaction documentation
gaps.description: README describes modules in isolation but doesn't explain how they interact (e.g., IoT pipeline → digital twin → decision support → API gateway).
gaps.impact: Users don't understand the system as a whole.
gaps.recommendation: Add a 'Module Interactions' section with sequence diagrams showing data flow between modules.

gaps.title: README lacks configuration documentation
gaps.description: No documentation on configuration options. The project has configurable parameters (heartbeat timeout, GPU device, batch size, rate limits, thresholds) but no configuration guide.
gaps.impact: Users don't know what can be configured or how.
gaps.recommendation: Add a Configuration section documenting all configurable parameters, their defaults, and how to set them.

gaps.title: README lacks performance characteristics
gaps.description: No documented performance characteristics (time complexity is in module table but no benchmark results, throughput, or latency data).
gaps.impact: Users cannot assess fitness for their use case.
gaps.recommendation: Add a Performance section with benchmark results, scalability limits, and hardware recommendations.

gaps.title: README lacks troubleshooting section
gaps.description: No troubleshooting or FAQ section in README. Common issues are not addressed.
gaps.impact: Users struggle with common problems.
gaps.recommendation: Add a Troubleshooting section with common issues: GPU not detected, ONNX model loading failure, import errors, test failures.

gaps.title: README lacks community/support section
gaps.description: No links to community channels, support, or discussion forums.
gaps.impact: Users don't know where to get help.
gaps.recommendation: Add a Community section with: Discord/Slack link, GitHub Discussions, Stack Overflow tag, email contact.

gaps.title: README lacks badges
gaps.description: No CI status, coverage, PyPI version, or license badges.
gaps.impact: Reduced discoverability and trust.
gaps.recommendation: Add badges: CI status, code coverage, PyPI version, license, Python versions.

gaps.title: README lacks screenshot/demo
gaps.description: No screenshots, GIFs, or demo links for the dashboard or visual outputs.
gaps.impact: Hard to understand what the system looks like without running it.
gaps.recommendation: Add dashboard screenshot, architecture diagram image, and link to live demo if available.

gaps.title: No type stubs or py.typed marker
gaps.description: The project uses type hints but has no py.typed marker file, so type checkers won't use the inline types for external consumers.
gaps.impact: Type information not available to downstream users.
gaps.recommendation: Add py.typed marker file to src/ and configure pyproject.toml to include it in package data.

gaps.title: No OpenAPI/Swagger spec export
gaps.description: The FastAPI app generates /docs but there's no exported OpenAPI spec file for API consumers.
gaps.impact: API consumers cannot generate client SDKs.
gaps.recommendation: Add a script to export OpenAPI spec to docs/openapi.json. Document how to generate client SDKs.

tsp.py.notes: Good class docstrings, minimal method docs

recommendations_priority: 5. Add examples/ directory with runnable scripts
6. Add docs/ directory with structured documentation
16. Populate all __init__.py files with docstrings and re-exports
17. Add comprehensive method docstrings to all public APIs
18. Expand README with module examples and configuration docs
